title: River boat trip with the Kansas City Rockets and Jesse Stone
summary: He played dances on a boat down the Missouri and up the Illinois to Peoria, with Jesse Stone arranging, before a wire came from Blanche Calloway.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: So after that, I went back to Kansas City with Thamon Hayes. Anyway, we called ourselves Thamon Hayes and the Kansas City Rockets by then. And we took a boat down the Missouri River, down to St. Louis, and came up the Illinois River, up to Galesburg, Illinois. Galesburg or Peoria...? Oh, Peoria. To Peoria. And we docked there for about two or three weeks. Every night we was playing on this boat, you know. We stopped at each town every night and gave a dance right on the boat, the boat ride, you know, on a trip down to Missouri and up to Illinois. And every night we...

We had a swell arranger in that band, too, named Jesse Stone. Oh, Jesse Stone was way ahead of everybody. He was a very great arranger and a piano player. In fact, he was an all-around good musician. I guess he's still living; I think he is.

And I got a wire from Blanche Calloway to join her in Memphis. So I... Things looked kind of slow for the band, you know. We wasn't getting much money on that boat thing, you know, getting a little bit...getting bored and (?), you would call it, on a boat. It wasn't really...you know...
